blocks.text: Setting up your Notion workspace on Mac

The first step for any office manager is ensuring your Mac environment is ready. Download the desktop app from the Notion website. Ensure you are running macOS 13 or later. Once installed, use the ⌘ + N shortcut to create a new page instantly. Organize your workspace using a sidebar structure that separates team resources from private administrative notes.
Essential Notion database tips for office managers

Databases are the core of your office management system. Create a master database for inventory. Use the Table view to list items, then switch to a Board view to track maintenance status. Add a Date property for recurring office inspections. If you need to filter your view, press ⌘ + F to search within the database or use the filter icon in the top right.

items: Use /table to insert a new database block.
Add a Select property to tag items by room or department.
Use the formula property to calculate total costs of office supplies.
Lock your database pages using the page menu to prevent accidental edits.
Create a template for weekly office walk-throughs to save time.

blocks.text: Speeding up your workflow with Lazur

Lazur helps you navigate Notion without moving your hands from the keyboard. When you are unsure where a specific setting is, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask Lazur to point it out. It circles the button on your screen. If you are drafting a policy document, hold fn to dictate your thoughts. This keeps your hands on the keys and your focus on the content.

Office managers often juggle Slack, email, and Notion. Keep your communication logs inside Notion. Create a page for meeting minutes. Use the @ symbol to mention team members. If you need to embed a calendar or a spreadsheet, use the /embed command. This keeps all necessary information in one place, reducing the need to switch between apps.
Use ⌘ + P to open the command search bar. Type the name of any page to jump to it instantly. This is faster than clicking through the sidebar.

blocks.text: Common mistakes and how to avoid them

Many managers overcomplicate their databases. Start simple. Only add properties you actually use. Avoid creating too many sub-pages, as this makes navigation difficult. If you find yourself lost, use the breadcrumbs at the top of the Notion window to return to your workspace home. Regularly check your trash to clear out deleted pages that are no longer needed.

faq.question: How do I check if my Mac is compatible with the latest Notion app?
faq.answer: Notion requires macOS 13 or later. You can check your version by clicking the Apple menu and selecting About This Mac.

faq.question: Can Lazur edit my Notion pages for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or edit files. It points at elements, explains how to perform tasks, and dictates text for you to use.

faq.question: What is the best way to handle office inventory in Notion?
faq.answer: Use a database with a gallery view. This allows you to see images of office supplies alongside their stock status and reorder dates.
